description: This file defines a Spring configuration class for setting up a batch job related to adding periodic accrual entries in a loan accounting system. It includes bean definitions for a job, a step, and a tasklet, utilizing Spring Batch components and Fineract-specific classes.

classes.name: AddPeriodicAccrualEntriesConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class for setting up the batch job, step, and tasklet related to adding periodic accrual entries in loan accounts.

methods.name: addPeriodicAccrualEntriesStep
methods.description: Creates and returns a Spring Batch Step that executes the addPeriodicAccrualEntriesTasklet.

methods.name: addPeriodicAccrualEntriesJob
methods.description: Creates and returns a Spring Batch Job that ties the step into a complete job with a RunIdIncrementer.

methods.name: addPeriodicAccrualEntriesTasklet
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of AddPeriodicAccrualEntriesTasklet, injecting the LoanAccrualsProcessingService.
